newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Prague Teplarenska agrees CZK 28 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Prague Teplarenska agrees CZK 28 dividend.

text.p: Shareholders of Prague district heating company Prazska Teplarenska a.s. agreed a 28 crown per share gross dividend on 1996 profit, after paying no dividend on the previous year's earnings, the company said on Monday.
An official with the company's board of directors told Reuters that the dividend was approved at the company's annual general meeting on Friday.
The company posted 1996 net profit of 235 million crowns, down from 281 million crowns the previous year.
